Explanation: The Luxury Listing is the Core Value Unit in this historical snapshot: a designer-fashion item offered by an individual Seller and made searchable and purchasable through Tradesy.
Tradesy operated the U.S. fashion-resale marketplace in this historical snapshot. Vestiaire Collective acquired Tradesy in April 2022, and Tradesy ceased processing new orders in December 2022.
Tradesy tried to make peer-to-peer designer resale simple and trustworthy enough for mainstream fashion Buyers and Sellers.
More trusted supply and demand could generate commission revenue and strengthen the marketplace brand.
Luxury resale requires costly trust mechanisms, while standalone marketplace scale and liquidity remain difficult to sustain.
